title: Lack
subtitle: 「缺乏／不足／短缺／不存在」，究竟是哪一種 lack？
description: 「缺乏／不足／短缺／不存在」，究竟是哪一種 lack？

words.note: 表示某種需要的東西數量不夠，常見於人手、住房、物資、能源、食物等。
words.example: The hospital is facing a shortage of nurses.

exercises.original: The hospital is struggling because of a lack of nurses on night shifts.
exercises.zh: 醫院因夜班護士短缺而運作困難。

options.explanation: nurses 是明確可數資源，而且仍有部分護士在職；重點是人手數量不夠，最適合 shortage。
強調資源稀缺、供應難以取得，常見於經濟／環境語境。 本題的關鍵線索要求另一種更精確的「缺乏／不足」關係，因此不如 shortage 合適。
通常是可量度的差距，低於所需、目標或正常水平。 本題的關鍵線索要求另一種更精確的「缺乏／不足」關係，因此不如 shortage 合適。

falseSynonyms.zh: shortage 通常指需要的東西數量不夠；lack 更廣，可表示完全沒有或抽象不足。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON There is a shortage of nurses. There is a lack of trust between the two teams.

falseSynonyms.zh: deficiency 常指必要成分、營養素、能力或品質不足，比一般 lack 更正式、更具體。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The patient has an iron deficiency. The report notes a lack of communication.

falseSynonyms.zh: absence 通常表示完全沒有；lack 可以只是程度不足。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON There was an absence of evidence. There was a lack of strong evidence.

falseSynonyms.zh: scarcity 常指資源稀缺、難以取得；lack 不一定涉及供應市場或資源分配。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The region faces water scarcity. The plan failed because of a lack of coordination.

falseSynonyms.zh: deficit 通常可量度，表示低於所需或目標的差額。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The company reported a budget deficit. The project suffered from a lack of leadership.

falseSynonyms.zh: dearth 是較正式的「稀少、匱乏」，常用於 information、evidence、skills 等。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON There is a dearth of reliable evidence. There is a lack of clear guidance.

falseSynonyms.zh: unavailability 表示需要時無法取得，不一定代表整體供應量很少。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The delay resulted from the unavailability of parts. The delay resulted from a lack of planning.

falseSynonyms.zh: lack 可作名詞或動詞；lacking 常作形容詞／分詞，表示欠缺某品質。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON There is a lack of detail. The explanation is lacking in detail.
